title: Infernal Infinity
description: A mod which aims to add an unnecessary amount of vanilla feature variants.
body:
_**This mod does not take itself very seriously, nor should you.**_

This mod aims to add a lot of content revolving around features within the base game. This includes block, item, entity, biome, and dimension variants, all focusing on the vanilla materials and resources. A builder's delight with a sprinkle of other aspects along the way.

# Additions
As of v1.0.1, the mod adds:
- Block Variants
  - Stair Variants
  - Slab Variants
  - Fence Variants
  - Wall Variants

This is a fraction of what is planned, with plans to expand this much deeper, to an excessive depth. The plan is to make it so that every material (dirt, stone, wood, etc.) can be made into any block type (stair, fence, button, etc.) and block texture type (brick, polished, tile, etc.) Eventually with plans to expand to other feature types.

# Known Issues
As of v1.0.1, the known issues are:
- Makes the inventory problem worse
  - This is planned to be addressed eventually, unsure how
- Recipe conflicts between new and vanilla recipes
  - Is being counteracted via stonecutter recipes

# Technical Details
- Fabric Loader Version: 0.18.4 (v1.0.0)
- Dependencies:
  - Fabric API (Required)
